✨ vps-audit | Shell
🎯 Primary Use Case: Auditing the security and performance of Linux Virtual Private Servers (VPS) to identify vulnerabilities and areas for improvement.
✨ Key Features: • Comprehensive security checks (SSH, Firewall, Fail2ban/CrowdSec, Failed Logins, System Updates, Running Services, Open Ports, Sudo Logging, Password Policy, SUID Files)
📖 Summary: vps-audit is a lightweight, dependency-free Bash script designed for comprehensive security and performance auditing of Linux servers. It checks SSH configuration, firewall status, intrusion prevention, system updates, running services, open ports, and more, providing real-time feedback and detailed reports with actionable recommendations.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

✨ avoid-ai-writing | JavaScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: To enhance the human-like quality of AI-generated text by identifying and correcting AI writing patterns, making content more natural and less detectable as machine-generated.
✨ Key Features: • Audits and rewrites content to remove AI writing patterns • Supports detect-only and edit-in-place modes • Includes optional voice profiles (casual, professional, technical, warm, blunt)
📖 Summary: This JavaScript skill audits and rewrites content to remove common AI writing patterns, making text sound more human. It supports multiple modes like detection-only, full rewrite, and in-place editing, along with customizable voice profiles.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source

💡 zedis | Rust
🎯 Primary Use Case: Providing developers with a fast, efficient, and feature-rich graphical interface for interacting with and managing Redis databases, especially those with large datasets.
✨ Key Features: • Native, GPU-accelerated rendering with Rust and GPUI • Efficient handling of millions of keys with virtual scrolling and low memory footprint • Intelligent data viewers for various Redis types and formats (JSON, Protobuf, MessagePack, images, hex)
📖 Summary: Zedis is a high-performance, native GUI client for Redis, built with Rust and GPUI. It offers a smooth, GPU-accelerated user experience with minimal memory usage, designed to handle large databases efficiently.
🔗 Links: • View Project • Homepage ================ 🔓 Open Source
